_comment_how_to_use: Copy this file, edit the fields, then run: ./make-song.sh my-song.json — see SONG_GUIDE.md for every field. Keys starting with '_' are comments and are ignored. style and lyrics are the only required fields.
_comment_variant_naming: For variant testing, copy this request and change id/variant/seed only: song-001-a, song-001-b, song-001-c ... The catalog groups them by 'concept'.
title: replace with a short display title
style: REPLACE: language, genre, instruments, vocal character, mood, tempo, N BPM — one line, comma-separated
lyrics:
[Verse]
REPLACE with one lyric line per line
REPLACE keep lines short and singable

[Chorus]
REPLACE the hook, the most memorable lines

[Bridge]
REPLACE optional contrast section
vocal: replace: e.g. female lead / male lead / wordless pads
